main.description: Lists a community's moderation audit log.

community.description: The community to list the moderation log for.

limit.description: Maximum number of log entries to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.
Pagination cursor for the next page, if more entries exist.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller lacks the moderation.viewLog permission.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: No community exists at the given DID.
